spec.kitLine: Activates when firing the last bullet
spec.assertion: Grant count > 1 and > Sin's burst-cast count, and shots >> grants (60-round mag). Fails under a `passive` encoding (one apply at frame 0), a `burstCast` encoding (capped at cast count), and a `shotFired` encoding (~60x too many applies).

Asserts the emitted stat is `maxHpFlat`, self-targeted, with expiresFrame - applyFrame == 300 (5s @60fps) and durationShots undefined. Fails under a permanent encoding, a durationShots (round-count) encoding, and an `allies` target set. The BASIS (highest ally's Max HP) is it.skip'd: no `highestAllyMaxHpPct` StatKey exists, and Sin (Defender) is usually the Max-HP leader herself, so caster/target/highest coincide and the divergence is unobservable on this fixture.

totals(noS1) deep-equals totals(base): Sin has no atkOfMaxHpPct consumer and ally-granted Max HP never feeds a teammate's conversion (e3 rule). Fails if the HP duplication were mis-encoded as any ATK-flavored grant.
it.skip — aggro/threat has no v1 payload (no enemy entity; boss deals no damage). Covered indirectly by the skill1-strip totals equality.

Every burstGenPct apply frame is in the fullBurstEnd frame set and in NO fullBurstStart frame. Paired with counterfactual E (same stat/value/duration, trigger re-keyed to fullBurstEnter) which produces a strictly different, earlier-starting frame list — proving the frame assertion is non-vacuous.

value === 16.17 exactly (burstGenPct is a plain percentage stat — raw kit number, NOT flat-resolved), self-targeted, 300-frame window. Fails on any magnitude slip, on an allies target set, and on a wrong duration.
Every defPct apply lands on a frame where Sin herself cast (burstCast with srcSlot === Sin). Fails under a fullBurstEnter key, which over-fires on rotations where a different B3 completes the chain.
First defPct (step 3) apply frame >= the THIRD burst cast frame. Fails under a flattened non-escalating encoding that applies all three payloads on the first cast.
value === 43.2, 300-frame window, self. defPct is documented inert in v1 (self DEF does not affect own damage) — kept for schema completeness and future consumers per failure-mode #7.

it.skip — no HP pool at scope lock. Its only non-inert path is the TANDEM case (a teammate with an on-recovery trigger, Crown-style); the control comp carries no recovery consumer, so it is untestable here. Guarded negatively by the skill-bucket equality assertion (goes RED if the lifesteal were mis-encoded as a flatDamage rider).
it.skip — no StatKey exists and heal magnitudes are unmodeled (the `heal` effect carries no HP amount), so a healing-received multiplier has nothing to scale.

HIGHEST LEVERAGE. Zero boss-held buffApply with stat damageTakenPct and value 12.23 (filtered by casterIdx === null && targetIdx === null per the boss-debuff convention). Counterfactual D ships the debuff UNGATED and is proven strictly hotter on Sin and on >= 3 units total — confirming the absence assertion is non-vacuous and that the mis-encoding inflates the WHOLE TEAM, not just Sin. The schema has no enemy-count gate; the faithful encoding omits the block and records the line in `unmodeled`.

Burst-bucket damage events exist; totals(base)[sin] > totals(noBurst)[sin]; every instance has fbMajorApplied falsy (verified fact: burst-cast damage lands before Full Burst begins — no +50%) and rangeApplied falsy (riders are force-set no-range). Fails under a fullBurstEnter-keyed encoding riding the +50% major.
Stripping the burst slot leaves every teammate's total byte-identical — the line is pure self-sourced damage carrying no team buff or boss debuff. Fails if any buff/debuff leaked into the burst slot.

fixtures: controlComp('sin', true) for all six runs. Sin is Burst II, so the control's B1 (liter) and B3 (carry/helm) slots supply a complete castable chain — Full Bursts genuinely occur and Sin genuinely casts her own burst, which every trigger in this kit (lastBullet aside) depends on; a lone unit makes ZERO Full Bursts. Deterministic, no seed. Runs are hoisted at module scope: (base) shipped override; (noS1/noS2/noBurst) per-slot strips for inertness and non-vacuity; (wrongDmgTaken) the ungated >4-enemy Damage Taken debuff — the nearest-wrong for the highest-leverage line; (wrongGaugeTrigger) fullBurstEnd re-keyed to fullBurstEnter — the nearest-wrong for trigger identity. The fixed-B3 flag is left true: Sin's kit reads no teammate state, so the helm slot's buffs cannot confound any assertion here (all assertions are event-identity or per-slug-delta, never absolute damage).
gaps: skill1 basis identity — 'Duplicate 15.03% Max HP of ally with the HIGHEST Max HP' has no `highestAllyMaxHpPct` StatKey (contrast the existing `highestAllyAtkPct`). casterMaxHpPct and targetMaxHpPct both resolve off the wrong unit whenever another ally out-HPs Sin; as a Defender she is usually the Max-HP leader, so all three coincide on this fixture and the divergence is unobservable. Needs either the StatKey or a higher-Max-HP-ally fixture.
skill1 'Attract: Taunt all enemies for 5 sec' — aggro/threat is unmodeled; no enemy entity in v1 and the boss deals no damage.

skill2 'Once: Recover 15.3% of attack damage as HP for 5 sec' — no HP pool at scope lock. Non-inert only via the tandem path (a teammate with an on-recovery trigger); the control comp has no recovery consumer, so it is untestable on this fixture.
skill2 'Twice: Incoming healing ▲51% for 5 sec' — no StatKey and no consumer; heal magnitudes are not modeled at all, so a healing-received multiplier has nothing to scale.

burst '>4 enemies' gate — the schema has no enemy-count gate primitive. The line is unconditionally FALSE at scope lock (one boss), so omitting the block + recording it in `unmodeled` is faithful TODAY; it would become wrong for any multi-enemy content.
